```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(thematic)

# Enable thematic for consistent plot theming
thematic::thematic_shiny(font = "auto")

# Define custom theme with Bootswatch "darkly"
custom_theme <- bs_theme(
  version = 5,
  bootswatch = "darkly",
  primary = "#2c3e50",
  secondary = "#3498db",
  base_font = font_google("Inter"),
  heading_font = font_google("Roboto"),
  "font-size-base" = "1rem"
)
```

```{r}
# Load dataset (replace URL with your dataset if needed)
online_retail <- read_excel("~/student/online_retail.xlsx")

# Preprocess data
retail_data <- online_retail %>%
  rename(
    UnitPrice = Price,      # Rename Price to UnitPrice
    InvoiceNo = Invoice     # Rename Invoice to InvoiceNo
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    InvoiceDate = as.Date(substr(InvoiceDate, 1, 10), format = "%Y-%m-%d"), # Extract only the date
    TotalPrice = Quantity * UnitPrice  # Compute total price
  ) %>%
  filter(Quantity > 0, UnitPrice > 0)  # Remove negative quantities and prices

head(retail_data) # View first few rows

```

```{r}
ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "Online Retail Dashboard",
  theme = custom_theme,
  sidebar = sidebar(
    title = "Controls",
    selectInput(
      inputId = "x_var",
      label = "X-Axis Variable",
      choices = c("Quantity" = "Quantity", "UnitPrice" = "UnitPrice", "TotalPrice" = "TotalPrice"),
      selected = "Quantity"
    ),
    selectInput(
      inputId = "y_var",
      label = "Y-Axis Variable",
      choices = c("UnitPrice" = "UnitPrice", "Quantity" = "Quantity", "TotalPrice" = "TotalPrice"),
      selected = "UnitPrice"
    ),
    selectInput(
      inputId = "color_var",
      label = "Color By",
      choices = c("Country" = "Country", "Description" = "Description"),
      selected = "Country"
    ),
    sliderInput(
      inputId = "point_size",
      label = "Point Size",
      min = 1,
      max = 5,
      value = 2,
      step = 0.5
    ),
    selectInput(
      inputId = "country_filter",
      label = "Filter by Country",
      choices = c("All", unique(retail_data$Country)),
      selected = "All",
      multiple = TRUE
    )
  ),
  # Main content with cards and value boxes
  layout_columns(
    col_widths = c(4, 4, 4),
    value_box(
      title = "Total Sales (£)",
      value = textOutput("total_sales"),
      showcase = icon("sterling-sign"),
      theme = "primary"
    ),
    value_box(
      title = "Average Order Value (£)",
      value = textOutput("avg_order_value"),
      showcase = icon("cart-shopping"),
      theme = "secondary"
    ),
    value_box(
      title = "Unique Customers",
      value = textOutput("unique_customers"),
      showcase = icon("users"),
      theme = "success"
    )
  ),
  card(
    full_screen = TRUE,
    card_header("Interactive Scatter Plot"),
    card_body(
      plotOutput("scatter_plot")
    )
  )
)
```


```{r}
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Reactive data with country filter
  data <- reactive({
    df <- retail_data
    if (!"All" %in% input$country_filter && length(input$country_filter) > 0) {
      df <- df %>% filter(Country %in% input$country_filter)
    }
    # Limit to top 1000 rows for performance in scatter plot
    df %>% slice_head(n = 1000)
  })

  # Value box outputs
  output$total_sales <- renderText({
    format(round(sum(data()$TotalPrice, na.rm = TRUE), 2), big.mark = ",")
  })

  output$avg_order_value <- renderText({
    avg <- data() %>%
      group_by(InvoiceNo) %>%
      summarise(OrderTotal = sum(TotalPrice, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      summarise(AvgOrder = mean(OrderTotal, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      pull(AvgOrder)
    format(round(avg, 2), big.mark = ",")
  })

  output$unique_customers <- renderText({
    length(unique(data()$CustomerID))
  })

  # Scatter plot
  output$scatter_plot <- renderPlot({
    # Handle Description as color variable by taking top 10 products for clarity
    if (input$color_var == "Description") {
      top_products <- data() %>%
        count(Description, sort = TRUE) %>%
        slice_head(n = 10) %>%
        pull(Description)
      plot_data <- data() %>% filter(Description %in% top_products)
    } else {
      plot_data <- data()
    }

    ggplot(plot_data, aes_string(x = input$x_var, y = input$y_var, color = input$color_var)) +
      geom_point(size = input$point_size) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        x = input$x_var,
        y = input$y_var,
        color = input$color_var
      ) +
      # Log scale for UnitPrice and TotalPrice to handle skewed distributions
      scale_x_continuous(trans = if (input$x_var %in% c("UnitPrice", "TotalPrice")) "log10" else "identity") +
      scale_y_continuous(trans = if (input$y_var %in% c("UnitPrice", "TotalPrice")) "log10" else "identity")
  })
}
```


```{r}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
